To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the internal circulation within a jet cocoon is dominated by a backflow towards the central regions of the host galaxy.

The relativistic jet of a central black hole carves out a cocoon within the interstellar medium of its host galaxy; the jet’s hot spot creates a signiﬂcant gradient in the density and entropy, which in turn creates a large-scale backﬂow of gas towards the inner parsec region; this backﬂow is signiﬁcantly larger than that due to gravitational torques, and it supplies the central black hole with gas at very low angular momentum

1) the backflow is a consequence of the large scale circulation within the coccon; 2) this circulation is generated due to the Crocco theorem; and 3) we have developed an analytic model for the backflow and have validated it using 2D simulations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the internal circulation within a relativistic jet, and the backflow of material towards the central region.
the internal circulation withinthe cocoon carved out of the interstellar medium of the host galaxy of an active galacticnucleus (AGN).
the internal circulation within a cocoon carved outby a relativistic jet from an AGN in the interstellar medium of its host galaxy.

AGNs self-regulate their own activity, through the backflow of material which they themselves have ejected.
the self-regulated AGN feedback model is a very good model to describe the evolution of the central region of the host galaxy.
the AGN activity is self-regulated by the backflow of material into the AGN, and that the backflow rate is determined by the mechanical power of the jet.

we have shown that the AGN activity can self-regulate itself by feeding the AGN from its own outflow.
we have shown that the AGN activity is self-regulated from backflow.

the backﬂow of gas towards the centralregion of the AGN is an important process, which can self-regulate the AGN activity,by providing the fuel needed to power it.
the AGN is able to self-regulate the rate at which it accretes gas from the ISM of the galaxy, and thus its own power.
